details_read.summary: 取得已訓練模型與固定比較
details_read.understanding: English rule Transformer text_foundation is distinct from Chinese bigram/window MLP. Public inference JSON is a labelled paper example: --tokens32 is a new-unit maximum, early EOS may stop at two units, byte73 decodes A and2 is EOS. simple_models fixed comparisons vary window1/3/5; exported inference weights do not promise exact resume.

details_read.summary: 故事、切詞與固定對話實驗
details_read.understanding: Fixed schedules are distinct from mini CLI. text_foundation, real_text, tokenizer, sft are separately selected runs with default outputs/course-experiments/course-v1/<name>/. Fetch tinystories/chinese-poetry for real text and ultrachat-sft for fixed sft. sft/model.pt is direct chat; pretrain/pretrain-sft are a separate two-stage branch. BPE requires its paired tokenizer JSON; mini attributes.pt cannot replace downstream fixed sft. sft_ablation needs the fixed sft result.

details_read.summary: 固定風格、安全與 LoRA 比較
details_read.understanding: Fixed style/safety/LoRA differ from mini independent exercises. Safety compares safety-only vs safety plus arithmetic replay from fixed style content.pt, with refusal/normal/arithmetic denominators distinct. PKU preferences and safe labels select a preferred safe demonstration, not a matched toy box permission test; truncated context limits claims. LoRA adapter needs original base/hash; merged weights must not receive the same adapter again. PKU noncommercial licence and redistribution restriction are explicitly separated from own box data.

details_read.summary: 續訓、固定模態比較與自己的檔案
details_read.understanding: Exact unfinished-task resume needs multimodal-v1 optimizer/progress/random/trainable names and same task/data/steps/freeze; public inference export is different. Fixed sft then encoders/projector/vqa is a separate recipe. Fixed vqa partial opens image projector plus last text block, unlike CLI first and last blocks. Own images resolve relative to JSONL, RGB16x16 may erase small glyphs. Nonempty16kHz mono audio is required without auto-resampling; sample rate is distinct from pitch. OCR donor replacement still scores original answer and separately checks donor answer.

details_read.summary: DPO 固定配方與 PPO 選卡路線
details_read.understanding: Fixed DPO requires fixed style then ultrafeedback-dpo and dpo CUDA; mini200updates/preferred.pt is another run. Save policy/reference/preference split and distinguish preference versus arithmetic tests. Independent posttraining CPU chooses prewritten cards rather than autoregressive tokens; DPO/PPO are alternative teaching routes. No convention for --temperature0 is given.

details_read.summary: 現代零件與效率的固定配方
details_read.understanding: TinyStories from T1 precedes modern or moe selected CUDA experiments. T10 uses moe/model.pt and moe/dataset.json from the moe branch. Efficiency and precision additionally require T4 fixed sft; format support must be reported rather than inferred from cuda. Timings need warmup/sync/multiple-sample medians and clear scope. Tensor allocated/current/peak/increment are distinct. flash_probe tests fixed QKV forward/backward, not whole training. verification_passed means at least one verified supported route and all supported routes completed, not every possible route successful; SDPA name alone is insufficient Flash evidence.

details_read.summary: 固定量化與量化感知訓練
details_read.understanding: Fixed quantization first needs fixed sft and performs120updates before conversion, unlike the single-conversion mini exercise. Float/4bit/8bit questions use a saved common comparison. QAT adapts to simulated rounding error; real low-bit backend format and hardware support are separate.

details_read.summary: 原始資料、教師與多模態路線
details_read.understanding: Teacher/student/control/generations are reported per domain. Multimodal distillation requires fixed vqa and fixed joint with original splits. Fixed joint reads sft plus encoders directly, not vqa, and is distinct from CLI checkpoints/joint.pt and chapter19 capstone_joint. The runner only performs the selected experiment, not missing dependencies. Inference archives alone lack training splits.

details_read.summary: 共同成品、成熟模型與完整歷史紀錄
details_read.understanding: Chapter19 fixed public CPU v2 has its parent weights/test/stage checkpoints without a private Volume; chapter20 upstream Qwen/Whisper are not own training. Historical RAG/tools/reasoning IO and denominators must be checked at their own routes. TOOL request alone is incomplete. Old messages list mutation does not change actual input IDs; errata was actually read in main, but raw files and script were not.
